items.source: Extension of PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver that also supports enhancing URIs using Spring HATEOAS support.
items.translation: 扩展了PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver，同时也支持使用 Spring HATEOAS 增强 URI。

items.source: Extracts paging information from web requests and thus allows injecting Pageable instances into controller methods.
items.translation: 从 Web 请求中提取分页信息，从而允许将 Pageable 实例注入到控制器方法中。

items.source: Extracts paging information from web requests and thus allows injecting Pageable instances into WebFlux controller methods.
items.translation: 从 Web 请求中提取分页信息，从而允许将 Pageable 实例注入到 WebFlux 控制器方法中。
